distinctness_checks.reason: Typed scene descriptions, nested version selection, anchors, geometric transform order and CLI description/refusal form a new implementation case. CS010 teaches GaAsync bind/map/mapError and bounded associativity with synthetic inputs.
Pre-render recursive expansion budgets, triangle arithmetic, guard counter/retained geometry and depth conventions are distinct from Godot save/load persistence, collider identity and ray probes.
Historical coexistence controls, timing endpoints, threshold sensitivity, dirty historical binary identity and a future cap experiment differ from installable multi-extension release-card gates.
